name: jev
description: Typed decisions as a noun: adds $.jev in the engine.create fold, so any plugin asks Jev a map of Choice, Score and Noul questions over one state and reads calibrated probabilities back — through the TypeSafe API, OpenRouter, Vercel AI Gateway, Cloudflare Workers AI, a LiteLLM proxy or any TypeSafe-compatible endpoint, picked from the environment.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Which gateway serves Jev. Leave on auto to use the first provider whose credentials are set.

model.title: Model
model.description: Overrides the default model for every call. Ids are not portable between providers.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Key for api.typesafe.ai, sent as the Authorization header to TypeSafe only.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: Key for openrouter.ai, sent to OpenRouter only.

ai_gateway_api_key.title: Vercel AI Gateway key
ai_gateway_api_key.description: Key for Vercel AI Gateway, sent to that gateway only.

cloudflare_api_token.title: Cloudflare API token
cloudflare_api_token.description: Workers AI token, sent to Cloudflare only.

cloudflare_account_id.title: Cloudflare account ID
cloudflare_account_id.description: Part of the Workers AI URL.

cloudflare_ai_gateway_id.title: Cloudflare AI Gateway ID
cloudflare_ai_gateway_id.description: Optional. Sent as the cf-aig-gateway-id header.

cloudflare_ai_gateway_url.title: Cloudflare gateway URL
cloudflare_ai_gateway_url.description: Optional. The whole URL to POST to, for your own Workers AI proxy.

litellm_api_key.title: LiteLLM API key
litellm_api_key.description: Key for your LiteLLM proxy, sent to that proxy only.

jev_endpoint.title: Custom endpoint
jev_endpoint.description: Any URL that speaks the System One wire.

jev_api_key.title: Custom endpoint key
jev_api_key.description: Key for the custom endpoint, sent to that URL only.
